input_proposals.interpretation: Depth-weighted concentration proxy; not a mass-weighted composite or carbon stock.
input_proposals.rationale: Nath explicitly defines topsoil as 0–30 cm. Other pooled contributors do not establish matching sampling depth; this is a design assumption, not verified cross-paper equivalence.
input_proposals.sensitivity: Evaluate the same response separately at each of the three depth layers; retain scores and unknowns, and report their range alongside the proposed summary score. Do not select the best layer or call this range a confidence interval.

dataset.access_validation: Not fetched; developer dataset_access.csv must identify representation, band, scaling and temporal reduction
dataset.limitations: Boundary data quality varies by country. Some protected areas are paper parks with little enforcement. Does not capture community conserved areas (OECMs) comprehensively. Not for: Legal compliance decisions; site-level permitting
preparation: Rasterize to 100m. Hard exclusion mask for IUCN categories Ia, Ib, II for agroforestry suitability (conversion not permitted). Categories V, VI may allow agroforestry within management plans — flag as conditional. Used by Chuma et al. (2021) as exclusion layer around Itombwe Nature Reserve.
dataset.prompt: Recipe fallback; no matching BIND row
dataset.source_unit_status: Consumer must verify native band units and scaling; canonical units are not native units

input_contract.candidate_dataset_role: WDPA supplies protected-area locations and attributes for assessment; it does not itself determine agroforestry permission.
input_contract.category_handling: No IUCN category, designation name or missing category is automatically permission or prohibition. Raw WDPA attributes must not be passed as the boolean mask.
input_contract.false: Named rules and coverage have been assessed; no applicable exclusion was identified within that assessment. This is not general legal clearance.
input_contract.geometry_handling: Unresolved point-only locations and boundaries remain unknown within their declared uncertainty/assessment extent; no invented universal buffer.
input_contract.legacy_rule: IUCN_Cat_I_II automatic exclusion retired: management category is not a universal intervention prohibition.
input_contract.outside_polygons: Absence from WDPA alone is not a false mask; record coverage and applicable national/site/project rules before assigning false.
input_contract.overlap_handling: Any confirmed applicable exclusion is true; otherwise any unresolved applicable assessment is unknown; false only when all relevant assessments are complete and non-excluding.
input_contract.true: Applicable legal or adopted project exclusion prohibits the proposed intervention at this location.
input_contract.unknown: Missing assessment, incomplete coverage, unresolved permission or absent usable geometry.

dataset.access_validation: Not fetched; developer dataset_access.csv must identify representation, band, scaling and temporal reduction
dataset.limitations: Mixed-pixel confusion in fragmented agricultural landscapes. Annual snapshot — does not capture seasonal cultivation. Accuracy lower in arid landscapes and under cloud cover. Not for: Crop-type mapping; sub-field land use classification
preparation: Reclassify to agricultural mask (cropland, grassland, sparse vegetation) to define eligible agroforestry conversion area. Exclude built-up, water bodies, bare soil with high salinity. Aggregate to 100m or 1km for pipeline. Used as LULC base by multiple AF studies.
dataset.prompt: Recipe fallback; no matching BIND row
dataset.source_unit_status: Consumer must verify native band units and scaling; canonical units are not native units

input_contract.code_handling: Exact categorical codes; no bilinear interpolation. Masked, unknown and unlisted codes remain unknown.
input_contract.grassland_input: managed_forage_without_grazing: 1 confirmed managed forage without grazing; 0 confirmed absent/incompatible; null not assessed or missing. Required only for class 30.
input_contract.non_conversion: Tree cover, shrubland, bare ground, wetlands, mangroves and moss/lichen are unresolved for this gate; do not infer permission to convert native vegetation.
input_contract.scope: Existing host-system screen for planted silvoarable; not conversion permission or biophysical suitability.
input_contract.spatial_handling: Evaluate classes and conditions at source support before area summaries. Retain eligible, ineligible and unknown fractions separately; do not turn any eligible subpixel into full-pixel planting area.
input_contract.time_handling: 2021 classification is historical context; record any newer/local replacement and its explicit class crosswalk.

holds: Target applicability, dataset contracts, host inputs and legal mask must be resolved before a spatial run

baseline: Current CIAT implementation: weighted linear combination plus separate gates; original minimum-factor design differs
criteria: Select one function per system and canonical criterion; resolve correlated groups before assigning weights
host_combination: AND within a configured host branch; permitted perennial host crops OR; preserve fractions and driver; no area double-counting
missing_values: Fixed criterion set; propagate unknown; no per-pixel renormalization
required_developer_checks: Explicit system and contextual transfer decisions
Full criterion set, aggregation and weights
Known excluded, unknown and scored outputs kept distinct
weight_validation: Final selected nonnegative M1 score weights sum to one; masks and operational factors excluded
